component.name: Uni-Staller
component.summary: Universal software installer for sovereign stacks

description.p: Uni-Staller generates ready-to-run bootstrap scripts for any operating system from a single interface — no cloud, no telemetry. Pick what you want from a curated catalog and it emits a deduped, correctly ordered shell or PowerShell script you can inspect before running.

ul.li: Windows (Tiny11), CachyOS, Bazzite, Fedora, Ubuntu/Debian, Arch

description.p: Each target carries a JUMPSTART block (base tools, runtimes, Ollama, companion models) plus a full category library — development, CLI AI tooling, gaming, audio and DAW, game engines and 3D, 3D printing, SDR and radio — and a Gap-Fill Companion catalog of general desktop apps the curated stack does not cover.
All nine OS tabs complete, each with its own script generator and Gap-Fill catalog.
